The §3Blast Furnace§r is a solid fuel-powered furnace used to create alloys from two inputs, accepting ingredients in multiple forms including powders. The main starter alloys are §6Minecraft Grade Copper§r, §6Steel§r, and §6Advanced Alloy§r - the latter being a combination of the former two. Advanced Alloy can be crafted into very durable tools that come with vein mining.

Along with the main product, each smelt also produces §6Slag§r and §bFlue Gas§r. Piping in §bHot Air§r at §e200 mB/t§r can accelerate production up to §e500%§r of the base rate.

A separate block, the §3Blast Furnace Extension§r, can be placed on top to triple the processing rate. Fuel consumption remains constant, so the extension also triples fuel efficiency.

§2For more advanced tools, pressing the ALT key brings up a menu to select multiple abilities at once.
